title: Modeling Motivated Reasoning in Law: Evaluating Strategic Role Conditioning in LLM Summarization

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate summaries of court decisions from the perspectives of different legal roles (e.g., defense attorney, prosecutor, judge) and measuring the selective inclusion of facts and legal reasoning (cherry-picking), as well as calculating a favorability bias score (the difference between inclusion rates of favorable versus unfavorable information) using LLM-as-a-judge pipelines and human evaluations.
